full_prompt_en: A direct black-and-white studio-style photograph shows two young adults seated close together before a lightly patterned wall. The person on the left wears a light suit jacket, collared shirt, tie, and dark sunglasses. They sit squarely with forearms resting forward, expression calm and assured. The person on the right wears a broad woven hat, oversized round sunglasses, and a patterned short-sleeved outfit. One arm rests casually across the companion's shoulder, bringing the two figures into a compact shared pose. Both face the camera without smiling, allowing clothing, posture, and the small gesture of contact to carry the portrait. The wall behind them has faint floral or scrolling marks, worn areas, and vertical panel lines, adding texture without overwhelming the figures. Light is broad and frontal, softly shaping faces and garments while leaving deeper tones in the sunglasses, hat brim, and folds of fabric. The grayscale has warm printlike midtones rather than stark pure black and white. Fine grain and slight unevenness at the edges give the photograph a tangible vintage surface. The crop ends around the waist, keeping the pair close to the viewer and balancing the smooth suit with the more graphic patterned fabric. The image feels both composed and relaxed, celebrating self-presentation through an ordinary backdrop and confident, understated style.
full_prompt_zh: 一张直接的黑白影棚式照片，拍下两位年轻人紧靠着坐在带浅花纹的墙前。左侧人物穿浅色西装外套、翻领衬衫和领带，戴深色太阳镜。坐姿端正，前臂向前搭放，神情平静而自信。右侧人物戴宽大的编织帽与夸张圆形太阳镜，穿短袖花纹服装。一只手臂自然搭在同伴肩上，使两个人收拢成紧凑的共同姿态。两人都面对镜头而不微笑，服装、姿态和轻微身体接触承担了肖像的表达。身后墙面有隐约花纹或卷曲痕迹、磨旧处和竖向板缝，增添纹理而不淹没人像。光线宽而正面，柔和塑造面孔和衣物，太阳镜、帽檐与布料褶皱里留下更深色调。灰阶带有温暖相纸般的中间调，而非极端纯黑纯白。细颗粒和边缘轻微不均匀让照片有可触的复古表面。构图裁至腰部，让两人贴近观者，平滑西装与更图形化的花纹布料取得平衡。图像既经过安排又松弛，以普通背景和自信、低调的装扮呈现自我表达。
style_prompt_en: Direct monochrome photography with warm printlike midtones, fine grain, and a lightly weathered surface. Broad frontal light softly models close central forms while dark lenses, shadowed upper edges, and fabric folds supply stronger accents. Smooth tailored planes contrast with woven texture and repeated graphic pattern. A faintly marked wall offers vertical structure without competing for attention. The framing is compact and human-scale, with adjacent forms linked by a relaxed diagonal gesture. Contrast is controlled rather than extreme, giving the composition an assured, candid vintage character.
style_prompt_zh: 直接的单色摄影风格，温暖相纸般中间调、细颗粒和略带风化的表面。宽阔正面光柔和塑造靠近的中心形态，深色反光面、上部阴影与布料褶皱提供较强点缀。平滑剪裁平面与编织纹理、重复图案对照。带浅痕的墙面提供竖向结构，却不争夺注意。取景紧凑，贴近人的尺度，相邻形态由松弛的斜向手势连起。对比受控而非极端，使构图有自信、抓拍般的复古气质。
theme_en: A stylish pair seated closely before a patterned wall
theme_zh: 时髦二人紧靠着坐在花纹墙前

reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
